0.q: In the nucleotide sequence of SvHKT2;1, 63 nucleotides from the 5′-end of the SvHKT2;2 sequence were deleted, in addition to the substitution of six nucleotides.

1.q: HvHKT2;1 lines, as well as SvHKT2;1 and SvHKT2;2 lines, showed faster root growth and higher shoot Na+ and K+ concentrations than in WT under K+-starved conditions, despite low root ionic concentration.

2.q: HvHKT2;1 lines, as well as SvHKT2;1 and SvHKT2;2 lines, showed faster root growth and higher shoot Na+ and K+ concentrations than in WT under K+-starved conditions, despite low root ionic concentration.

3.q: SvHKT1;1 produced inward and outward currents when oocytes were bathed in both NaCl and Na-gluconate solutions… indicating that the SvHKT1;1 transporter mediates Na+, but not K+ or Cl−, transport.
